messages:
Nora (Design): Quick idea drop: a 'mini-grid' layout for latency — compact rows (48-64px) stacked in a dense grid. Each cell shows: big p95, tiny stacked bars for p50/p95/p99 (1px height each), a miniature time-spark (16px), and a sampling badge. Goal: scan 60+ routes fast. thoughts?
Sam (PM): Love dense scanning. Must make regressions idiot-proof and enable one-click jump to traces. Also want the time-range picker to persist per-dashboard.
Devon (Eng): Backend notes: we can return p95 & 3 small relative bar values + an 8-bin sparkline. Exact histograms for every cell is heavy. Recommend approximate percentiles via t-digest sketches and pre-bucketed sparklines.
Ravi (Data): API suggestion: `GET /metrics/latency?routes[]=...&bins=8&percentiles=50,95,99&approx=true` -> `{p95_est:230, p50:50, p99:720, bins:[...], sample_rate:0.1, conf_ms:12}`. UI should show `~` badge and `conf_ms` as text.`
Maya (A11y): A11y nits: do not use color-only state. tiny bars + color won't help low-vision. Add small glyphs (arrow/up/down) and a short text readout on focus like "p95 230ms, up 120ms". The mini-spark must be keyboard-focusable and expand to provide text-bin list for screen readers. Also ensure touch targets >=44px.
Nora (Design): Good catches. Microcopy plan: primary line `p95 230ms` (high contrast), right-side tiny `~` badge with `aria-label="Values approximate (sampling enabled)"`. On focus open an inline overlay with: full histogram, percentiles list, `Open traces` link. For uncertainty show `7230ms b115ms` inline (i.e., `p95 ≈ 230ms (±15ms)`).
Sam (PM): Copy for sampling toggle & confirm: in-card hint: `Approximate values from 10% sampling`. Confirm modal: `Run exact query to compute precise metrics. This may take up to 30s and increase cost.` Button: `Run exact query` (warn before starting).
Devon (Eng): Implement exact-run as async job + poll endpoint, return a job id. Add rate limit per-org and preflight estimate: `This exact query may take ~12s`. Also cache exact results for 5 minutes and mark UI as `cached` when used.
Ravi (Data): Suggest also returning a short natural-language histogram summary for SRs: `hist_summary`: "Most requests 10-40ms; tail at 700ms" so screen readers get content without parsing arrays.
Maya (A11y): Important: uncertainty must be textual for SRs: e.g., "p95 230ms plus or minus 15ms". Keyboard users must be able to expand then tab to `Open traces` link. Provide `aria-expanded` on the cell.
Nora (Design): Interaction notes I'll mock: hover (mouse) shows tiny overlay, keyboard focus opens persistent overlay, Enter toggles expand, Escape closes. Mobile: tap opens overlay. I'll add a11y annotations and microcopy in Figma.
release-bot: deployed mini-grid-latency-preview to staging: https://staging.redwood/team/dashboards — iteration 2
Sam (PM): Great. Nora, can you post the Figma link before lunch so eng can validate the API fields? We'll run a quick playtest next week.
Nora (Design): Will do — aiming for two variants (ultra-compact + compact-with-overlay) in Figma in ~90 mins. :coffee:
